stage_definitions.internal_working_product: Model implemented and tested internally; no pilot user; no commercial agreement.
stage_definitions.controlled_internal_pilot: Real human user onboarded with B7 acknowledgement; controlled environment; no commercial agreement.
stage_definitions.controlled_paid_pilot: Real human user onboarded with paid-pilot agreement and no-go acknowledgement; controlled environment; documented commercial terms; not a customer reference.
stage_definitions.enterprise_saas_readiness: Multi-tenant architecture, SLA/SLO, audit-grade logging, pricing/packaging, external security review, B1 external review output, generic solar and wind parity, completed pilot, separate governance change. Explicitly not the current goal.

gate_definitions.PG-01: Controlled internal pilot completed (pilot result summary filed).
gate_definitions.PG-02: Pilot result reviewed by project lead (signed review note in pilot result summary).
gate_definitions.PG-03: B3 matrix updated with pilot results (at least one B3 area moved to pilot_user_tested or higher; or recorded demotion with rationale).
gate_definitions.PG-04: B11 commercial messaging guardrail tested against a real demo (at least one demo run with no guardrail violations recorded).
gate_definitions.PG-05: B12 heatmap updated to reflect pilot results (at least one B12 area's confidence label updated, or recorded no-change rationale).
gate_definitions.PG-06: Paid pilot user agreement drafted (document exists; reviewed by project lead and legal if applicable).
gate_definitions.PG-07: Paid pilot scope and inputs documented (specific area, specific inputs, expected output range documented).
gate_definitions.PG-08: Paid pilot data isolation verified (production / customer / NDA data not accessible).
gate_definitions.PG-09: Paid pilot environment provisioned (environment is up, observable, secure).
gate_definitions.PG-10: Paid pilot no-go acknowledgement drafted (pilot user and operator have signed).
gate_definitions.PG-11: Paid pilot support / incident response in place (tiers defined, on-call assigned, communication channel set).
gate_definitions.PG-12: Paid pilot go/no-go decision memo filed (memo records the decision, rationale, and unresolved blockers).
gate_definitions.PG-13: B1 no-go list reviewed against paid pilot scope (no conflict).
gate_definitions.PG-14: B11 commercial messaging guardrail reviewed against paid pilot scope (no conflict).

PG-01_controlled_internal_pilot_complete.notes: No controlled internal pilot has run yet. The B9 execution pack and the B7 runbook are in place; the first controlled internal pilot is the prerequisite for PG-01.

PG-02_pilot_result_reviewed_by_project_l.notes: Depends on PG-01. Project lead review of the controlled internal pilot result summary is the prerequisite for PG-02.

PG-03_b3_matrix_updated_with_pilot_resul.notes: Depends on PG-02. B3 matrix update commit required.

PG-04_b11_commercial_guardrail_tested.notes: Depends on the B11 commercial messaging guardrail being exercised against a real demo. The guardrail is in place; the test run is the prerequisite for PG-04.

PG-05_b12_heatmap_updated.notes: Depends on PG-02. B12 heatmap update commit required.

PG-06_paid_pilot_agreement_drafted.notes: Agreement document not yet drafted. Drafting begins after PG-01 is passed.

PG-07_paid_pilot_scope_documented.notes: Scope not yet documented. Documentation begins after PG-06 is drafted.

PG-08_paid_pilot_data_isolation_verified.notes: Isolation verification depends on the paid pilot environment (PG-09) and the data manifest (PG-07).

PG-09_paid_pilot_environment_provisioned.notes: Environment provisioning is the operational prerequisite. Includes observability and security baseline per the B8 deployment and observability dimensions.

PG-10_paid_pilot_no_go_acknowledgement_d.notes: Acknowledgement depends on PG-06 (the agreement) and on the B1 no-go list (B1, merged).

PG-11_paid_pilot_support_incident_respon.notes: B7 support / incident response procedure is in place; paid pilot scope adds commercial escalation, which is documented in the paid pilot agreement.

PG-12_paid_pilot_go_no_go_decision_memo_.notes: Memo (per the decision memo template) is filed when all other gates are passed.

PG-13_b1_no_go_list_reviewed_against_pai.notes: Review depends on PG-07 (paid pilot scope) and on the B1 no-go list (B1, merged).

PG-14_b11_commercial_guardrail_reviewed_.notes: Review depends on PG-07 (paid pilot scope) and on the B11 commercial messaging guardrail (B11).

unresolved_blockers.blocker_description: B1 external review output is not yet produced. The scaffolding is in place; the review itself is pending.
B2 generic reference acquisition has not started. Zero references acquired; tooling not yet built; pins not yet added.
B7 controlled internal pilot has not yet run. The B7 runbook, B9 execution pack, and B13 paid pilot gate are in place; the first controlled internal pilot is the prerequisite for PG-01.
B12 heatmap is in its initial state. The heatmap will be updated as the B3 matrix changes and as the controlled internal pilot produces results.
B14 governance refresh tracker is in its initial state. The tracker will be updated as Agent A's next round of route / state work lands and the B-track governance docs need to be refreshed.

Phase 51N checkpoint has landed. B15 governance refresh has been executed on this branch (parallel-b15-b19-refresh-pilot-pack). 12 service-backed routes and 13 service modules are in place per Phase 51N. 5 inline hotspots remain and are tracked in B17 with expected future Agent A phase numbering 51O/51P/51Q/51R/51S. The paid pilot gates themselves (PG-01 through PG-14) are unaffected by Agent A's route extractions and remain pending until the first controlled internal pilot is completed.

Claude review is separate. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is not represented in this branch as completed. The paid pilot gate does not depend on Claude review; it depends on the controlled internal pilot result (PG-01), the B3 matrix update (PG-03), the B11 commercial guardrail test (PG-04), the B12 heatmap update (PG-05), and the B1 no-go list / B11 guardrail review (PG-13/PG-14).

stage_transitions.internal_working_product_to_controlled_i: Gate defined in B7 runbook §2 and B9 execution pack §4. Requires the B9 execution checklist to be all-passed and the first controlled internal pilot to be authorized.
stage_transitions.controlled_internal_pilot_to_controlled_: Gate defined in this file (B13). Requires all PG-01 through PG-14 to be passed. Decision is recorded in a memo per the decision memo template.
stage_transitions.controlled_paid_pilot_to_enterprise_saas: Gate NOT defined at this time. Enterprise SaaS readiness is explicitly not the current goal. See B8 tracker and the B14 refresh plan for future governance.

global_notes: This gate is the boundary between controlled internal pilot and controlled paid pilot. The four stages are defined in §1 of the narrative file.
The paid pilot is internal validation with a real human user, with an explicit commercial agreement, with documented no-go enforcement. It is NOT a customer reference and NOT external validation.
All PG-01 through PG-14 must be 'passed' for a 'go' decision. A 'go' decision without a memo is a gate violation. A 'no_go' decision requires a remediation plan.
The unresolved blockers list is the categories of blockers the gate will track when populated. None of the listed blockers are actual issues at package creation; they are pre-emptive categories.

B15 governance refresh added BLK-006 (Phase 51N checkpoint landed; B15 refresh executed) and BLK-007 (Claude review is separate; paid pilot gate does not depend on Claude review). All PG-01 through PG-14 remain pending; no paid pilot is authorized by this branch or by B15.

Claude review is separate. The B-track governance pack does not represent Claude review as completed. Phase 51N includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is reflected in B16 (External Review Closeout Tracker) only as a separate workstream.
